definitions: Sit on and control the movement of (a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle).
Travel in a vehicle, especially as a passenger.
Be carried or supported by (something in motion).
Continue without being affected or stopped by (something undesirable).
examples: She learned to ride a horse at a young age.
We rode the bus to the city centre.
The boat rode the waves smoothly.
He rides his bike to work every day.
The company rode out the economic downturn.
